info.title: Kubernetes Service API
info.description:
The Kubernetes Service API provides services that allows provisioning and life cycle
management of Kubernetes clusters.

get.description:
Returns the build version stamped into the running binary at release
time, allowing clients and CI gates to verify exactly which release is
deployed.

regionTypeParameter.name: regionType
regionTypeParameter.description: The type of region we are asking for.

tagSelectorParameter.name: tag
tagSelectorParameter.description:
A set of tags to match against resources in the form "name=value",
thus when encoded you get "?tag=foo%3Dcat&tag=bar%3Ddog".

kubernetesNameParameter.description: A Kubernetes name. Must be a valid DNS containing only lower case characters, numbers or hyphens, start and end with a character or number, and be at most 63 characters in length.

regionTypeParameter.description:
The region type. "physical" means a full Kubernetes cluster deployment, "virtual" is a virtual
Kubernetes cluster hosted by another one.

kubernetesClusterAutoUpgradeWindow.description:
Defines when in the day an upgrade is allowed to occur, specified as an
hour starting from 0 up to 23.  Upgrade windows can overflow into the next
day e.g. a start of 22 will begin upgrades from 10pm, and an end of 6 will
stop upgrades after 6am.

kubernetesClusterAutoUpgradeDaysOfWeek.description:
When defined allows explicit control of what days an auto upgrade can
occur on.

kubernetesClusterAutoUpgrade.description:
If set, enables auto-upgrade to a set schedule, or if not set, opts
out of upgrades entirely.  Upgrades still occur when the cluster's
application bundle reaches end of life irrespective of whether auto upgrades
are disabled. The absence of this object represents a default auto-upgrade policy of
the platform.

enabled.description: Whether or not auto upgrades are enabled.

nodePrefix.description: Network prefix to provision nodes in. Must be a valid CIDR block.

servicePrefix.description: Network prefix to provision services in. Must be a valid CIDR block.

podPrefix.description: Network prefix to provision pods in. Must be a valid CIDR block.

dnsNameservers.description: A list of DNS name server to use.

items.description: A DNS name server IPv4 address.

subjectAlternativeNames.description: Set of non-standard X.509 SANs to add to the API certificate.

allowedPrefixes.description: Set of address prefixes to allow access to the Kubernetes API.

replicas.description: Number of machines for a statically sized pool or the maximum for an auto-scaled pool.

kubernetesClusterAutoscaling.description:
A Kubernetes cluster workload pool autoscaling configuration. Cluster autoscaling
must also be enabled in the cluster features.

minimumReplicas.description: The minimum number of replicas to allow. Must be less than the maximum.

labels.description: Workload pool key value labels to apply on node creation.

kubernetesClusterWorkloadPools.description: A list of Kubernetes cluster workload pools.

hardwareEnablement.description:
Enables and hardware operators and drivers for the cluster e.g.
GPU operator, network configuration, etc.

kubernetesClusterControlPlane.description:
Defines explicit control plane topology. When not specified, the platform
will automatically select an appropriate flavor.

flavorId.description: Flavor ID for control plane nodes.

replicas.description:
Number of control plane replicas. Must be an odd number to
maintain quorum. Defaults to 3 if not specified.

clusterManagerId.description:
The name of the cluster manager to use, if one is not specified
the system will create one for you.

version.description: The Kubernetes version.  This should be derived from image metadata.

applicationBundleName.description: An explicit set of applications to use for deploy.

virtualKubernetesClusterWorkloadPools.description: A set of virtual workload pools.

virtualKubernetesClusterWrite.description: Virtual Kubernetes cluster create or update.

virtualKubernetesClusters.description: A list of virtual Kubernetes clusters.

authorizationServerList.description: List of authorization servers that can grant access to the resource.

items.description: An authorization server's scheme and hostname.

scopeList.description: A set of OIDC scopes that are required for authorization.

bearerMethodList.description: A set of bearer token transport methods supported by the protected endpoint.

resource.description: The protected resource's scheme and hostname.

serviceVersionRead.description:
Build version information for the running service, stamped into the
binary at release time.  Developer builds report version 0.0.0.

version.description: The service release version, e.g. v1.2.3.

error.description: Generic error message, compatible with oauth2.

A terse error string expanding on the HTTP error code. Errors are based on the OAuth 2.02 specification, but are expanded with proprietary status codes for APIs other than those specified by OAuth 2.02.

trace_id.description: Unique trace identifier for the request.

kubernetesLabelValue.description:
A valid Kubernetes label value, typically used for resource names that can be
indexed in the database.

tag.description:
A tag mapping arbitrary names to values.  These have no special meaning
for any component are are intended for use by end users to add additional
context to a resource, for example to categorize it.

resourceMetadata.description: Metadata required for all API resource reads and writes.

description.description: The resource description, this optionally augments the name with more context.

staticResourceMetadata.description:
This metadata is for resources that just exist, and don't require
any provisioning and health status, but benefit from a standardized
metadata format.

creationTime.description: The time the resource was created.

createdBy.description: The user who created the resource.

modifiedTime.description: The time a resource was updated.

modifiedBy.description: The user who updated the resource.

resourceProvisioningStatus.description: The provisioning state of a resource.

resourceHealthStatus.description: The health state of a resource.

resourceReadMetadata.description: Metadata required by all resource reads.

deletionTime.description: The time the resource was deleted.

regionFeatures.description: A set of features the region may provide to clients.

physicalNetworks.description:
If set, this indicates that the region supports physical networks and
one should be provisioned for clusters to use.  The implication here is
the region supports base-metal machines, and these must be provisioned
on a physical VLAN etc.

physicalCount.description: The physical number of GPUs (cards) available.

logicalCount.description: The logical number of GPUs available as seen in the OS.

baremetal.description: Whether the flavor is for a dedicated machine.

cpuFamily.description: A free form CPU family description e.g. model number, architecture.

memory.description: The amount of memory in GiB.

disk.description: The amount of ephemeral disk in GB.

pinnedOnly.description: When true, a server using this flavor must specify an infrastructureRef to identify the target host.

imageVirtualization.description: What type of machine the image is for.

osFamily.description: A family of operating systems.  This typically defines the package format.

variant.description: A free form variant e.g. desktop/server.

codename.description: A free form code name e.g. warty/bionic.

version.description: Version of the operating system e.g. "24.04".

semver.description:
A semantic version in the form v1.2.3.
Pre-releases and variants are not currently supported.

gpuModelList.description: A list of GPU model numbers.

driver.description: The GPU driver version, this is vendor specific.

sizeGiB.description: Minimum disk size required to use the image in GiB.

images.description: A list of images that are compatible with this platform.

organizationScopedResourceReadMetadata.description: Metadata required by organization scoped resource reads.

organizationId.description: The organization identifier the resource belongs to.

projectScopedResourceReadMetadata.description: Metadata required by project scoped resource reads.

projectId.description: The project identifier the resource belongs to.

virtualKubernetesClustersResponse.description: A list of virtual Kubernetes clusters.

openidProtectedResourceResponse.description:
OpenID configuration used to discover authentication servers when hitting
a protected endpoint.  This is returned to the client when an authorization
error is encountered so they can discover how to authenticate.

serviceVersionResponse.description: Build version information for the running service.

unauthorizedResponse.description: Authentication failed or the access token has expired.

internalServerErrorResponse.description:
An unexpected or unhandled error occurred. This may be a transient error and
may succeed on a retry.  If this isn't the case, please report it as an issue.

metadata.name: uk-west-1
metadata.description: A top secret datacenter somewhere in the UK

badRequestResponse.description:
Request body failed schema validation, or the request does not contain
all the required fields.

forbiddenResponse.description:
Request was denied by authorization, this may be caused by the authorization
token not having the required scope for an API, or the user doesn't have the
necessary privileges on the provider platform.

example.error_description: user credentials do not have the required privileges
the requested resource does not exist

imagesResponse.description: A list of images that are compatible with this platform.

conflictResponse.description: Resource conflicts with another, usually this means they have the same name.

example.error_description: a resource with the same name already exists

acceptedResponse.description:
The request has been accepted and will be fulfilled asynchronously.
You may poll the resource and monitor its provisioning and health status
to await completion of the operation.

oauth2Authentication.description: Operation requires OAuth 2.0 bearer token authentication.
